sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 860)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across two comedy panel broadcasts on BBC Radio 4's *Just a Minute* (1999, 2004), two globe-trotting espionage assignments on *John Steele, Adventurer* (1949, 1955), daytime serial drama on *Young Widder Brown* for Sterling Drug (1950), and romantic daytime serial drama on *Hearts in Harmony* for Kroger Grocery (1946).
All episode titles maintain strict canonical naming, with credited panellists, cast, and sponsors recorded in the narrative description:
